text: 金十数据7月29日讯，中国人民银行等九部门联合印发《关于加强科技金融领域数据开发利用的通知》。《通知》坚持加强科技金融领域数据开放共享和融合运用，支持科技信息使用机构规范运用科技公共数据，鼓励地方向科技型企业提供授权开放信息渠道，推广信息查询、联合建模等模式。开展科技金融可信数据空间创新发展试点，鼓励有条件的地区加强企业收支流水数据开放利用，搭建行业研究信息交流平台，实现科技金融领域数据资源跨域共享和高效对接。支持市场化征信机构建设科技型企业数据库，丰富征信产品和服务供给。
text_en: Jin10 Data, July 29: The People's Bank of China and eight other departments jointly issued the 'Notice on Strengthening Data Development and Utilization in Sci-Tech Finance.' The Notice emphasizes enhancing open sharing and integrated use of sci-tech finance data, supporting sci-tech information users in standardizing the application of public data, encouraging local governments to provide authorized information channels for sci-tech enterprises, and promoting models like information inquiry and joint modeling. It launches innovative sci-tech finance trusted data space pilot projects, encourages eligible regions to strengthen open use of enterprise cash flow data, builds industry research information exchange platforms, and achieves cross-regional sharing and efficient matching of sci-tech finance data resources. It supports market-oriented credit agencies in building sci-tech enterprise databases, enriching credit product and service supply.
